# Invest in Short Term Rentals
> Educational resource for investing in short-term rental properties.

## About
Invest in Short Term Rentals is an educational platform for real estate investors interested in building wealth through Airbnb, VRBO, and other short-term rental strategies. The site provides market analysis, investment guides, and practical advice for STR property acquisition and management.

## Key Pages
- Home: https://www.investinshorttermrentals.com/
- Blog: https://www.investinshorttermrentals.com/blog
- Resources: https://www.investinshorttermrentals.com/resources
